expo.name: NetworkOS
expo.description: A private, local-first network for remembering the people and relationships that matter.

plugins.contactsPermission: NetworkOS imports people from your phone contacts when you choose to, and — only if you turn on phone book sync — keeps those imported contacts up to date. It never changes your phone contacts.

plugins.calendarPermission: NetworkOS reads upcoming events on this device to match attendees with your contacts.
plugins.remindersPermission: NetworkOS does not create or read reminders. iOS asks for this because calendar access and reminders share one system permission group.

plugins.photosPermission: NetworkOS uses your photo library only to attach a picture to a contact you choose.
plugins.cameraPermission: NetworkOS uses the camera only to take a picture for a contact you choose.
